current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly I’ve been getting really snappy and having these temper outbursts… and then I feel bad after. At home and at school I keep getting into conflicts, and I got suspended too.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to stop getting so angry, honestly. And… maybe have more friends, do better at school.

medications.current_medications: Medication 1: Name Or Description: Methylphenidate short-acting.; Dose: Uh, it’s 10 mg in the morning and then 5 mg at noon.; Start Or Duration: Started September 2024.; Side Effects: It makes lunch kind of a pain — my appetite’s lower then.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My father.; Diagnosis Or Condition: Anxiety and depression.; Additional Details: My mother has ADHD, and my maternal grandfather had alcohol use disorder.

personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: Well, I’m in grade 6 now, so… school’s been hard, and I’ve been having trouble there. Not really jobs or anything, just the school stuff.

personal_history.future_goals: I want more friends, and to do better at school… and, I guess, manage my anger better.
